messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: meta-CFA. Weighted correlation matrix.
parts:
Hi,
      I was looking to run a meta-CFA using Lavaan(). Essentially, I am hoping to extract a weighted correlation matrix which I can then run through lavaan to calculate the fits for the data weighted my sample size. Alternatively, if lavaan can extract a weighted correlation matrix, one could calculate the model in MPLUS. Has anyone run this type of analysis before ? 

  Kind Regards,
         Conal

messages.author: 13deaaee5806ffce
messages.subject: Re: meta-CFA. Weighted correlation matrix.
parts:
Hi Conal,

It seems that this is a standard meta-analytic structural equation modeling (MASEM).

You may try the metaSEM package (https://cran.r-project.org/package=metaSEM).

Best,
Mike

messages.author: 13deaaee5806ffce
messages.subject: Re: meta-CFA. Weighted correlation matrix.
parts:
Hi Conal,

It is hard to tell what happened without the data. If you can post your model and data at http://openmx.ssri.psu.edu/forums/third-party-software/metasem I will be able to take a look at it. Moreover, it is also better to post questions related to metaSEM (and OpenMx) there.

If you were referring to the first stage of the analysis, coef() returns the weighted correlation matrix using ML estimation. The weights can be based on either a fixed- or a random-effects model.

Best,

Mike
